title: Import the /graphql-client subpath — the reactor-browser package root does not bundle for browsers
content:
## The failure

```tsx
// ✅ bundles in Next, Vite or anything else, with no alias or stub
import { GraphQLReactorProvider } from "@powerhousedao/reactor-browser/graphql-client";

// ❌ drags a Postgres driver and node built-ins into a browser bundle
import { GraphQLReactorProvider } from "@powerhousedao/reactor-browser";
```

The package root re-exports the whole package, and part of that **value-imports** `@powerhousedao/reactor`, whose single entry reaches `pg` (`dns`/`fs`/`net`/`tls`), `@electric-sql/pglite` and `node:worker_threads`. None of it runs on the light-client path, but a browser bundler still has to resolve it — and Turbopack fails on `node:worker_threads` before any app code runs.

## Why the subpath is safe

The `/graphql-client` entry imports the reactor **for types only**. Types are erased at compile time, so a bundler never sees them. The few runtime values the client actually needs are mirrored inside `reactor-browser`, with compile-time assertions that fail if they ever drift from the reactor's own definitions.

The built entry imports exactly `react`, `document-model`, `graphql`, `graphql-request`, `graphql-tag`, `graphql-ws/client`, `@powerhousedao/shared/document-model`, `@powerhousedao/shared/document-drive`, `change-case`, `remeda` and `slug` — no database driver, no node built-ins. A test walks the entry's import graph and fails if that regresses.

## The general shape

This is a recurring class of failure, not a one-off: a package whose root entry serves both server and browser consumers will pull server-only backends into a browser bundle, and the fix is always to import the browser subpath. `@powerhousedao/reactor-attachments/client` is the same pattern. The monorepo's `test/test-fusion/` app is a worked example — it imports the subpath and has no bundler configuration at all.

_Source: apps/academy/docs/academy/04-Reference/08-ReactorBrowserClient/01-OverviewAndQuickstart.md (Powerhouse v6.2.2-dev.45)._
